Betul & Esra

Founders · Sweet Society Café

A little café with a big heart

At Sweet Society Café, every treat is crafted with passion and the finest ingredients. From your morning coffee to custom celebration cakes, we're here to make every moment a little sweeter.

The café is the next chapter of Kuzum Cookies — the studio Betul founded in 2013 and carried from İzmir to New Jersey, creating thousands of custom cakes for birthdays, baby showers, henna nights and weddings along the way. Together with co-founder Esra, she's now bringing that same care to a café of their own.

Can't wait to welcome you!
